layman_headline: Market is fearful and flat — patience is the play while existing positions build.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a state of mild fear but improving from deeper fear last week. Bitcoin is hovering above $64K while most altcoins are trading sideways or slightly down. Our two current positions in Solana and Chainlink are both slightly underwater but well within their stop-loss ranges. None of the new swing candidates present a compelling enough setup to justify adding risk right now.
layman_action: Hold your current positions in SOL and LINK. Both are near entry and within plan. Wait for a clearer setup before adding a third position — the market doesn't reward impatience in sideways conditions.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is weak this cycle. MON has a near-oversold RSI (39) but is below SMA20, down 56% from ATH, and lacks MACD or volume confirmation — a classic value trap profile in high BTC dominance. AKE is extremely overbought (RSI 92) after a 145% weekly run, making it a short candidate not a long. FIL is down 10.6% on the week but is 99.7% off ATH with no RSI data — a structural downtrend. WLD dropped 10% in 24h with no clear support level. LINK already ran 11.7% this week and is held. BTC dominance at 56.5% continues to suppress alt performance. The improving Fear & Greed (31→41) is a positive sign but not yet sufficient to trigger aggressive alt entries. Best strategy is to hold existing positions and wait for either a broader sentiment shift or a specific catalyst-driven setup.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.5% continues to drain capital from altcoins, pressuring SOL and LINK
BTC leveraged long liquidation levels (per CoinDesk headline) could trigger a cascade that drags all positions lower
Fear & Greed at 41 is improving but still fragile — could reverse back to deeper fear on any negative catalyst
watch_list: BTC price action around $64K — a break below $62K could trigger leveraged liquidations and alt selloffs
Fear & Greed index trajectory — needs to sustain above 40 and push toward 50 for alt confidence
LINK holding above $9.00 support — a close below would warrant reassessing the stop-loss at $8.60
market_context: Bitcoin is consolidating above $64K with 56.5% dominance, keeping altcoins suppressed. Fear & Greed has improved from 31 to 41 over the past week, suggesting sentiment bottoming, but conviction for new alt entries remains low.
context_banner: Sideways market with improving sentiment but no clear alt breakout catalyst — discipline over action.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed improved from 31 to 41 (weekly avg 32), suggesting sentiment is recovering but still in Fear territory — not yet bullish enough for aggressive alt positioning.
MON RSI at 39 is the only near-oversold reading among candidates, but lacks volume and catalyst confirmation, making it a low-conviction entry.
Headline warning about BTC leveraged long liquidation levels suggests downside risk if BTC breaks key support — historically unreliable source but the risk scenario is valid.
OCC approving Trump family crypto trust charter and Ripple adoption by Korean bank are moderately positive macro signals but not directly actionable for swing trades.
Ethereum TVL at $41.5B is stable with 0% 7d change, indicating no fresh DeFi momentum to drive alt rallies.
